page.layout: One page of text in a single column, Hebrew and Latin entries with hanging indents; running head at top, page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: בית דִּינָא Domus judicii, Curia: & metonymicè Senatus, Consistorium judiciale, Judices.
בית המִּרְדְּשׁ Domus inquisitionis, Schola, Gymnasiū, Cantic.2.4.5.
בֵּית זֵיתָא Domus olivæ, Olivetum, Lucæ 19.29.
בֵּית סָפְרַיָּא Domus scriptorum, librorum, Arca libraria, seu scriptis referta, 2.ad Timoth.4.13. Chald. Esrae 6.1.
בית מַטְרָא Domus custodiæ, Custodia, Carcer.
בֵּית מַכְסָא Domus tributorū, Teloniū, Matth.9.9.
בית עֲנָנָא Domus detentionis, Carcer, Jesa.24.22.
בית מְשַׁכְּבָא Domus cubationis, Cubiculum, Judic.15.1.
בֵּית מְלוֹנָא Domus diversorii, Diversorium, Marci 14.14.
בית קְבוּרְתָּא Domus sepulturæ, sepulchrum, &c. Maxima passim harum locutionum copia occurrit.
בֵּית מַרְזְבָּא Præfectus domus, Oeconomus, Luc.16.1.

בֵּיתָא Syr. Domus: בֵּיתָא Praefectura domus vel domestica, Oeconomia, Dispensatio: Tremell.explicat, Nutritio domus, 1.ad Corinth.9.17. Lucæ 16.2. Sed sicut בֵּית מַרְזְבָּא est Praefectus domus, sic בֵּיתָא Praefectura domus.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac vocalisation is approximate; the Hebrew/Aramaic words were reproduced from the scan as closely as legible, and several Hebrew lines are only partly legible. Marginal Hebrew pointing and small marks in the Hebrew lines may be imprecise.
